scope: HostBlockTop V-only native BF16 storage through existing StreamingDenseOwner, retained Matrix and single iDMA
policy_meaning: Owner-managed staging: tensor=1 selects native BF16 tensor storage; tile16=1 describes retained arithmetic tile granularity only, not a 16-token limit or a fixed staging batch. The existing owner chooses SRAM tiling and contexts. No norm/RoPE stages are executed.

address_extension.meaning: All local and extra-output address fields are zero sentinels. Host private SRAM is never addressed by these fields.

window: 1 <= count <= 128, base + count <= M without wrap. Full tensor allocation and permissions are checked first; A active window and full B must be readonly or actually published within this launch. D active window must be fresh.
publication: Publish exactly the active D interval only after matching successful owner completion with exact acknowledged byte count and acceptance of the Host completion. Untouched prefix and suffix are never published.
compatibility: The separately proposed version-1 SharedL2 candidate policy is outside this Host release and rejected by this route. Q/K, all other Qwen3.5 operations, and a full Qwen3.5 block remain unsupported. Existing FP32 Host operations retain their full_c MatrixAux encoding and false A/D BF16 flags.
